title: What Resume Template Should You Use? Where to Build It?
excerpt: In the academic world, the simpler your resume, the better. Here are the best free tools and templates for building one.

blocks.text: What Resume Template Should You Use? Where to Build It?

This topic is very interesting. Many times we see resumes that look very attractive and are written very nicely and well. But in the academic world, there's no place for these cute games and pretty games 😅
Remember this rule whenever you want to write an academic resume:
The simpler, the better Simple, veryyyyy simple Don't think that the prettier it is, the better it looks - no
Where to Find Simple Resume Templates
But the next question that comes up is, where do we find these simple resume templates?
1: Open a simple Word file yourself and start building your resume. This is the best thing you can do.
2: There are some templates on Canva that might be good and many of them are free. But many of these templates are really not good and not professional.
3: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to prepare a simple and standard template for you.
4: On Overleaf you can also find good templates.

Sites That Help You Write a Resume
In addition to the things I mentioned, there are also sites that help you write a resume and provide you with ready-made templates:
In my opinion they're not bad and they're good, but again I say, nothing is better than opening Word yourself and starting to write + the help of our good friend AI.
1. Reactive Resume
2. Overleaf
3. Resume.io
4. Oh My CV
5. Markdown Resume
6. WResume AI
7. Free Next Resume Maker

9. OpenResume
